privacy.disclosure: Prompts leave this device. OpenCode states zero retention and no training; service metadata and networked tools remain outside this inference claim.

Prompts leave this device. Every request carries provider.zdr=true, data_collection=deny and provider.only=[mistral, google-vertex, google-ai-studio], so OpenRouter routes Mistral models only to Mistral SAS in France and Gemini only to Google, and only to endpoints that do not retain prompts; a provider that cannot retain data also cannot train on it. Routing, host and retention are enforced per request; OpenRouter itself (New York) relays the request without storing it; third-party plugins such as web search have their own policies and are outside this claim.
